description.value:
By working through the schematics stored in your wristpad, you've gained the ability to cast tech powers. General techcasting rules and the tech powers list appear elsewhere in the rules.

Tech Powers Known. You start out knowing 3 tech powers of your choice, learning additional ones as you advance in fighter levels according to the Tech Powers Known column of the Shield Specialist Techcasting table. You cannot learn a power whose level exceeds your current Max Power Level.

Tech Points. Your pool of tech points, spent to fuel your tech powers, equals half your fighter level (per the Tech Points column of the Shield Specialist Techcasting table) plus your Intelligence modifier. A short or long rest restores all spent tech points.

Max Power Level. Many tech powers can be overcharged by spending additional tech points for a stronger effect. The highest level you may overcharge to rises as you gain fighter levels, per the Max Power Level column of the table. You can only cast a 4th-level tech power once between long rests; a long rest restores this ability.

Techcasting Ability. Your techcasting ability is Intelligence: use it whenever a power calls for your techcasting ability, and use your Intelligence modifier both to set the saving throw DC of a tech power you cast and to make an attack roll with one.

Tech save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier

Tech attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier

Techcasting Focus. Your wristpad itself serves as your focus for casting tech powers.
